summary: This note describes the children's program "Mr. Dressup" and its origins. The show was developed and produced by Daniel McCarthy, who later became head of children's programming for CBC Television. It was created as a replacement for "Butternut Square", on which Mr. Dressup had been a featured character.
one_line: Mr. Dressup, a CBC children's program developed by Daniel McCarthy as a replacement for Butternut Square.
key_facts: "Mr. Dressup" was developed and produced by Daniel McCarthy.

"Mr. Dressup" was developed as a replacement for the program "Butternut Square".
Mr. Dressup had been a featured character on "Butternut Square".
